Choose interactively

Open /provider to switch the active provider, then /models [filter] to browse that endpoint’s catalog. /settings brings provider, model, theme, and API-key settings together.

› /provider
› /models coding
› /settings

Supported providers

ProviderCredential
localNone. Any OpenAI-compatible server; defaults to Ollama at http://localhost:11434/v1.
openaiOPENAI_API_KEY
openai-codexChatGPT subscription through device login.
anthropicANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Uses the native Messages API.

Configure from the shell

SettingFlag / environment
Model--model NAME / ORCA_MODEL
Endpoint--base-url URL / ORCA_BASE_URL
API key--api-key KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY
OpenRouter--openrouter / OPENROUTER_API_KEY
Anthropic--anthropic / ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
Web tools--firecrawl-key KEY / FIRECRAWL_API_KEY

Flags and environment values take precedence over saved values.

Saved configuration

Orcacode stores the provider, last model per provider, theme, API keys, extension settings, MCP servers, skills overrides, and workspace-scoped approvals at ~/.config/orcacode/config.json by default. Set ORCA_CONFIG_DIR to relocate it.

For an OpenAI ChatGPT subscription, select openai-codex in /provider; Orcacode opens a device login flow and can import an existing official Codex login as a fallback.
